patch_resolves_note: The official patch.diff did not apply to the Stage 01 checkout, so fixed-side evidence comes from the authoritative n132/arvo:23816-fix image. On the original PoC that build still records a false scope-ID guard at parse_ip_literal() but never reaches parsed_host_return; the adjacent `scope_id_pct25_0` case records a true guard and executes parsed_host_return on the fixed side.

root_cause_criterion.obligation: Before parse_host() accepts a bracketed IP-literal host and returns it through `host`, any scope delimiter `%` must either be absent or begin the RFC 6874 `%25` ZoneID prefix.
root_cause_criterion.fix_mechanism: The fixed code moves bracketed-host validation into parse_ip_literal(), which rejects the original `%20` scope suffix before the host-return path and only returns a host when the scope delimiter is absent or valid for the active parse mode.
root_cause_criterion.evidence: The vulnerable original trace records scope_id_guard.scope_id_guard_satisfied == 0 while parsed_host_return still executes. The fixed original records the same false predicate but no parsed_host_return event, and the fixed scope_id_pct25_0 case reaches parsed_host_return with scope_id_guard.scope_id_guard_satisfied == 1.

nodes.description: At the source-level sink `memcpy (string->str + pos_unsigned, val, len_unsigned)`, the requested copy length exceeds the remaining NUL-terminated storage bytes reachable from `val`.
nodes.evidence: The vulnerable original trace records memcpy_sink.copy_len == 5 and memcpy_sink.remaining_storage_bytes == 2 at the crashing sink call.

nodes.description: When _uri_encoder() reaches the trailing high-bit byte of the accepted host string, it requests a 5-byte append even though only 1 byte remains in the encoder input window.
nodes.evidence: The vulnerable original trace records uri_encoder_tail.requested_copy_len == 5 and uri_encoder_tail.remaining_input_bytes == 1.

edges.description: The same oversized append length chosen in _uri_encoder() is forwarded unchanged into the later g_string_insert_len() memcpy call.
edges.evidence: The vulnerable original trace records uri_encoder_tail.requested_copy_len == memcpy_sink.copy_len == 5.

edges.description: The same parsed host buffer returned by parse_host() becomes _uri_encoder()'s `start` argument during URI reserialization, carrying the accepted malformed host into the overread path.
edges.evidence: The vulnerable original trace records parsed_host_return.host_ptr == uri_encoder_tail.start_ptr == 0x6020000000b0.
